argument: The rational mixed-kernel proof applies to the degree-plus-mixed matrix because three times each degree row and target equal the corresponding mixed-row sum and target.
Under integral unimodular Smith transformations, the binary row space has one direction for each odd nonzero Smith factor.

The quotient of half-even row-image classes by the binary row space has one direction exactly for each Smith factor with 2-adic valuation one. The eighteen directly contracted independent classes therefore give at least eighteen such factors.

The 7,713 odd factors and 18 valuation-one factors exhaust rational rank 7,731. Thus no nonzero Smith factor is divisible by 4. The equal characteristic-three rank excludes 3 from every nonzero factor.

For integral selectors obeying the exact Gram equations, rational compatibility forces the zero Smith-coordinate targets to vanish. Modulo-two compatibility forces even targets at the 18 even factors.

Choose each nonzero Smith coordinate as target divided by its factor and choose free coordinates zero. Cancel 2 where needed. Every denominator is coprime to six; applying the integral unimodular column transformation preserves this property.
A common denominator coprime to six is invertible modulo every modulus 2^r 3^s, so the same rational solution proves all of these modular compatibility statements.
